name: Lena Ehrenfeldt
source:
She is a Templar of the Blue Rose, a high order of elite knights in the kingdom of Tanves. She believes in being able to hold one's own and in fighting for what is right. Which means she can kick some serious butt if it comes down to it.

She is strongly dedicated to her cause, but soon realizes that that she has yet to find that one thing she must protect.

[from [url=http://hinoyabu.wordpress.com/2011/07/24/blue-rose-characters-lena/]Creator's blog[/url]]
